gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participants must have histologically or cytologically confirmed WHO grade 4 glioma (including tumors with molecularly defined grade 4 astrocytoma) for whom a clinically-indicated tumor resection is planned.

candidate_evidence.quote: While sitagliptin is FDA-approved for diabetes treatment, its use in glioblastoma is investigational (experimental).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Phase 2 and Pharmacodynamic Study of Sitagliptin in Patients With Progressive Grade 4 Gliomas
evaluate the safety and biological impact of sitagliptin treatment in patients with recurrent grade 4 glioma undergoing clinically indicated surgical resection

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Difference in tumor CD8+ T cell count between the participants randomized to pre-surgical sitagliptin versus the participants randomized to no pre-surgical treatment.

role_evidence.quote: Investigators hypothesize that treating GBM patients with sitagliptin will deplete circulating MDSCs and reduce their entry into the brain, reversing systemic and intratumoral immunosuppression.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: inhibiting an enzyme called dipeptidyl peptidase 4 (DPP-4), which MDSCs rely on to enter the brain and function
arms: Group 1: Presurgical and post surgical treatment with sitagliptin
Group 2: Post surgical treatment with sitagliptin

biomarkers.biomarker_other: tumour CD8+ T cell count (immune infiltration)

source_quote.quote: Difference in tumor CD8+ T cell count between the participants randomized to pre-surgical sitagliptin versus the participants randomized to no pre-surgical treatment.

arms: Group 1: Presurgical and post surgical treatment with sitagliptin
Group 2: Post surgical treatment with sitagliptin

coder_notes: Window-of-opportunity design: Group 2 (no pre-surgical sitagliptin, both arms EXPERIMENTAL) serves as the control for the primary tumour CD8+ endpoint, so control_arm_from_other_arms = yes. Population is WHO grade 4 glioma including molecularly defined grade 4 astrocytoma (IDH-mutant allowed), with glioblastoma named in conditions -> mixed_glioma_gbm_named; grade 4 glioma without IDH requirement -> historical. All patients receive post-operative chemotherapy with sitagliptin, but the chemotherapy is not named or registered, so not listed as an agent; regimen coded combination on that basis. Pre-operative dexamethasone appears only in eligibility; not listed. Tumour CD8+ T-cell count recorded as a pharmacodynamic 'other' biomarker (immune-cell, not strictly molecular).
